privacy.metaDescription: How Rankavio collects, uses, and protects your store's data inside the Snap6 AI Photo Studio app.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Rankavio (“Rankavio”, “we”, “us”) provides the Snap6 AI Photo Studio app (“Service”) for Shopify merchants, available at rankavio.com and as an embedded app inside the Shopify Admin. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
paragraphs: When you install Rankavio, Shopify shares certain store information with us via OAuth, and you may provide additional information by using the app's features:
items: Store information: your shop domain, store name, and the email address associated with your Shopify account.
Product data: titles, IDs, and images of the products you choose to work with inside the app.
Uploaded and generated images: product photos you upload and the AI-generated photo sets created for you.
Usage data: number of AI credits used, generation history, SEO audit results, and competitor analysis queries.
Billing data: your subscription plan and status. Payment is handled entirely by Shopify — Rankavio never sees your card details.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
paragraphs: We use the information above to:
items: Operate the Service — generate AI product photos, run SEO audits, and provide competitor insights for your store.
Track and enforce your plan's monthly AI credit allowance.
Save your generation history so you can review and re-download past results.
Provide customer support and respond to your requests.
Maintain, secure, and improve the Service.

sections.heading: 3. Third-Party Service Providers
paragraphs: To provide the Service, we share limited data with the following sub-processors, solely for the purposes described below. These providers process data only as needed to deliver their part of the Service and are bound by their own privacy and security commitments.
items: Shopify — authentication, store data access, and subscription billing.
Replicate (Flux Kontext Pro model) — processes the product photo you upload to generate new AI images.
Anthropic (Claude) — analyzes product information to power SEO audits and competitor analysis summaries.
SerpAPI — retrieves public search-engine results used for competitor analysis.
Cloudflare R2 — stores and serves your uploaded and generated images via a content delivery network.

sections.heading: 4. Data Storage & Security
paragraphs: Your data is transmitted over encrypted HTTPS connections and stored on reputable cloud infrastructure (Cloudflare R2 for images, a managed database for app data). Access is restricted to what's needed to operate and support the Service.
While we take reasonable measures to protect your information, no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: 5. Data Retention & Deletion
paragraphs: We retain your store's data for as long as the app remains installed, so that your generation history, SEO audits, and settings remain available to you.

If you uninstall Rankavio, Shopify notifies us via mandatory privacy webhooks (shop/redact, customers/redact, customers/data_request) and we delete or anonymize the corresponding store data in accordance with Shopify's requirements.
You may also request deletion of your data at any time by contacting us using the details below.

sections.heading: 6. Your Rights
paragraphs: Depending on your location, you may have rights under data protection laws such as the GDPR or CCPA, including the right to access, correct, export, or delete your personal data, and to object to or restrict certain processing. To exercise any of these rights, contact us — we will respond within a reasonable timeframe.

sections.heading: 7. Cookies & Tracking
paragraphs: Rankavio uses only the cookies and local storage necessary for the app to function — primarily to remember your language preference (Turkish/English). We do not use third-party advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.

sections.heading: 8. Children's Privacy
paragraphs: The Service is intended for business use by Shopify merchants and is not directed to individuals under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected by updating the “Last updated” date at the top of this page. Continued use of the Service after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.

sections.heading: 10. Contact Us
paragraphs: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how your data is handled, contact us at:

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service (“Terms”) govern your access to and use of Rankavio's Snap6 AI Photo Studio app (“Service”), provided via the Shopify App Store. By installing or using the Service, you agree to these Terms on behalf of yourself and the merchant account you represent.

sections.heading: 1. The Service
paragraphs: Rankavio helps Shopify merchants generate professional, category-specific AI product photography from a single uploaded image, and provides supporting tools such as SEO audits and competitor analysis.

sections.heading: 2. Subscription Plans & Credits
paragraphs: Rankavio offers Free, Solo, Pro, and Premium plans, each with a monthly AI credit allowance as described on the Pricing page and inside the app's Billing section.
Credits are consumed when you generate photo sets, run refinements, SEO audits, or competitor analyses. Unused credits do not carry over to the next billing period and reset monthly.
Paid subscriptions are billed in advance on a recurring monthly basis through Shopify's billing system, in accordance with Shopify's Merchant of Record terms and your Shopify Partner/store agreement.

sections.heading: 3. Changing or Cancelling Your Plan
paragraphs: You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your plan at any time from the Billing page inside the app.

Cancelling moves your store to the Free plan immediately. Any unused credits for the current period are forfeited, and Shopify will apply any applicable proration or credit to your store account in accordance with its billing policies.

sections.heading: 4. Acceptable Use
paragraphs: By using the Service, you agree that you:
items: Own or have the necessary rights to any product photos you upload, and to the products and brands shown in them.
Will not use the Service to generate content that is illegal, infringing, deceptive, or that depicts real people without consent.
Will not attempt to abuse, reverse-engineer, or overload the Service, or use it in a way that violates Shopify's Acceptable Use Policy or Terms of Service.

sections.heading: 5. Your Content & AI-Generated Output
paragraphs: You retain ownership of the product photos you upload and of the AI-generated images created for your store. You grant us a limited license to process your images solely to provide the Service.

AI-generated images are produced using third-party machine learning models and may occasionally contain artifacts, inaccuracies, or unexpected results. You are responsible for reviewing generated content before publishing it to your store or elsewhere.

sections.heading: 6. Service Availability
paragraphs: The Service depends on third-party providers (including Shopify, AI model providers, and cloud infrastructure). We aim for high availability but do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation, and we are not liable for outages caused by third-party providers.

sections.heading: 7. Limitation of Liability
paragraphs: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Rankavio and its operators shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from your use of the Service, including loss of revenue, data, or goodwill. The Service is provided “as is” and “as available” without warranties of any kind.

sections.heading: 8. Termination
paragraphs: You may stop using the Service at any time by uninstalling the app from your Shopify Admin. We may suspend or terminate access to the Service if these Terms are violated, or if required by Shopify.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to These Terms
